scientific_finding: Across two prospectively held-out stochastic trajectories, AuroraPIC preserves exact source-loss accounting and a stable integral-normalized ion-density shape with mean per-window Turner relative-L2 discrepancies near two percent. Both trajectories nevertheless retain slow global-density-amplitude evolution at the locked horizon. The repeated failure is therefore specific evidence against the present equilibration and stationarity protocol, not evidence of a broad conservation or spatial-profile defect.
engineering_consequence: Do not tune thresholds, select favorable windows, or pool these profiles. Return to design work on the density-amplitude mode using population, ionization, wall-loss, current, power, and controller-state diagnostics; then preregister a new independent-seed confirmation campaign.
claim_boundary: AuroraPIC has meaningful conservation, boundedness, and descriptive Turner-profile evidence, but this campaign does not support a stationary Turner Case 1 validation claim or general PIC validation.
